project.name: orazaka-end2end
project.description: Hermetic E2E Testing Module — Java/Web Router API validation only. Playwright Java, HTTPyac, CLI Validation (ADR-040). Mobile client testing is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for the JVM lifecycle — mobile validation runs in the CI mobile-validation track (ESLint + tsc --noEmit).

arguments.argument: pkill -f 'orazaka-apps/services/.*\.jar' || true; pkill -f 'orazaka-apps/workers/' || true; sleep 2; docker compose -p orazaka --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v || true
export NEXTAUTH_SECRET="${NEXTAUTH_SECRET}" NEXTAUTH_URL="${NEXTAUTH_URL}" ROUTER_URL="${ROUTER_URL}" NEXT_PUBLIC_UI_URL="${NEXT_PUBLIC_UI_URL}" && npx next dev

set -a && . ${maven.multiModuleProjectDirectory}/.env && set +a && export REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379 RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=true && exec java -jar ${maven.multiModuleProjectDirectory}/orazaka-apps/services/orazaka-conversation-service/target/orazaka-conversation-service-${project.version}.jar --spring.datasource.url=jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/${DB_NAME} --spring.datasource.username=${DB_USERNAME} --spring.datasource.password=${DB_PASSWORD} --server.port=${PORT}

echo.message: Router is UP — releasing to test runners.
